abstract: Maintains vessel tracking telemetry and transit voyage duration records
system_message:
You are the Marine telecommunications inspector (MTI). Your responsibilities include maintaining vessel tracking telemetry and transit voyage duration records, as well as conducting emergency communications audits for evaluated evacuation corridor plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains vessel tracking telemetry and transit voyage duration records（TEL）
information_points.content:
MTI-TEL-1VE：For the Southern Archipelago Protected Fairway, active emergency satellite beacon tracking is active based on real-time dual satellite telemetry transponders, and the maximum staging transit time between the island departure pier and mainland triage port is 120 min.
MTI-TEL-MG9：For the Eastern Channel Deepwater Passage, active emergency satellite beacon tracking is active based on real-time dual satellite telemetry transponders, and the maximum staging transit time between the island departure pier and mainland triage port is 240 min.
MTI-TEL-1RE：For the Northern Sound Catamaran Route, active emergency satellite beacon tracking is active based on real-time dual satellite telemetry transponders, and the maximum staging transit time between the island departure pier and mainland triage port is 150 min.

information_points.title: Emergency communications audit（COMMS）
information_points.content:
MTI-COMMS-BOP：For the Southern Archipelago Protected Fairway, the radio readiness drill score achieved by assigned rescue fleet communications operators during simulated distress signal exercises is 95 pt.
MTI-COMMS-8VI：For the Northern Sound Catamaran Route, the radio readiness drill score achieved by assigned rescue fleet communications operators during simulated distress signal exercises is 75 pt.
MTI-COMMS-YTG：For the Eastern Channel Deepwater Passage, the radio readiness drill score achieved by assigned rescue fleet communications operators during simulated distress signal exercises is 85 pt.
